# Cryptoimg — Hide Any Secret Inside Any Image

## Overview
Cryptoimg is an open-source, client-side steganography tool that hides files inside images using military-grade encryption. All processing happens locally in the browser — no data ever leaves your device.

## Core Technology
- **Encryption**: AES-256-GCM (authenticated encryption)
- **Key Derivation**: Argon2id (memory-hard KDF resistant to GPU/ASIC attacks)
- **Error Correction**: Reed-Solomon codes (survives JPEG recompression)
- **Steganography**: LSB (Least Significant Bit) embedding in variance-filtered pixels
- **Compression**: DEFLATE (zlib)

## Features
1. **Encode**: Hide any file (documents, archives, executables) inside an image
2. **Decode**: Extract hidden data using PIN code
3. **Album Mode**: Split large files across multiple images with automatic reassembly
4. **Inspector**: View image metadata and detect steganographic content
5. **Self-Test**: Automatic verification that encoded data can be extracted

## Supported Formats
- Input: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF (auto-converts to lossless)
- Output: PNG, WebP, AVIF (lossless)
- Maximum capacity: ~6.5 KB per 1920×1080 image, ~65 KB per 3840×2160 image

## Platforms
- **Web**: https://cryptoimg.wasmer.app
- **Windows**: NSIS installer + portable executable
- **Android**: APK (Android 7.0+)

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/cryptoimg
- Website: https://cryptoimg.wasmer.app
